description: Reference-image rotations for camera-facing static props. The existing unsuffixed PNG is the south-facing view.

directions.east: Show a strict orthographic right-facing side elevation. The functional front points exactly toward the right edge. The front and back faces must be edge-on and effectively invisible; show no diagonal, three-quarter, isometric, or perspective view.
directions.north: Rotate the object 180 degrees about its vertical axis in the world, so its functional front faces the top edge and its back is the primary visible face.
directions.west: Create this deterministically by horizontally mirroring the east image so left and right are the exact same side profile in reverse.

prompt_template: Use {source} as a strict character-sheet-style reference. Create the same {subject}, unchanged in design, proportions, colours, outline weight, materials, details and wear, in the requested {direction}-facing rotation: {direction_instruction} Keep the established Briefcase Game clean colourful office-cartoon style, bold dark navy outlines, polished hand-painted shading, orthographic camera elevated exactly 50 degrees above the floor with zero camera yaw, verticals vertical, and no perspective convergence. Put the object on a perfectly flat, uniform chroma-key magenta #FF00FF backdrop extending to every edge. Keep the complete object fully visible, grounded, centred, and tightly padded. Preserve lighting from upper left in world space. Produce one object only; no room, floor plane, people, text, logos, watermark, cropping, pixel art, photorealism, low-poly 3D, or pink object details.

postprocess: Generate and chroma-normalize the east side profile, create west by horizontally mirroring east pixel-for-pixel, and retain the independently generated north/back view. Review all four views together in the asset gallery before relying on them in the level.
